body:
You could have used `hasRefinements` [jsdoc](http://algolia.github.io/algoliasearch-helper-js/docs/AlgoliaSearchHelper.html#hasRefinements) but be careful as it automatically chooses from isConjunctiveFacetRefined isDisjunctiveFacetRefined and so on, so if the attribute is used in other widget with different kind of facet, it'll lead to bugs.

I think you are safer with `isFacetRefined`.
